description: Tool to run a customized realtime report of Google Analytics event data. Use when you need realtime data (last 30-60 minutes) with dimensions and metrics for a GA4 property.

inputSchema.description:
Request model for running a customized realtime report.
At least one dimension or metric must be specified.

dimensionFilter.description: Filter to restrict data by dimension values. Structure: {'filter': {'fieldName': 'country', 'stringFilter': {'value': 'United States'}}} or use andGroup/orGroup/notExpression for complex filters.
dimensionFilter.title: Dimension Filter

dimensions.description: Dimensions to group by (max 9). At least one dimension or metric is required. Valid names: appVersion, audienceId, audienceName, city, cityId, country, countryId, deviceCategory, eventName, minutesAgo, platform, streamId, streamName, unifiedScreenName. Custom: 'customUser:param_name'.

name.description: The dimension name. Valid realtime dimensions: appVersion, audienceId, audienceName, audienceResourceName, city, cityId, country, countryId, deviceCategory, eventName, minutesAgo, platform, streamId, streamName, unifiedScreenName. Custom dimensions use 'customUser:parameter_name'.
name.title: Name

dimensions.title: Dimensions

metricFilter.description: Post-aggregation filter on metric values. Applied after row aggregation.
metricFilter.title: Metric Filter

metrics.description: Metrics to measure (max 10). At least one dimension or metric is required. Valid names: activeUsers, eventCount, keyEvents, screenPageViews.

expression.description: Optional mathematical expression for a derived metric.
expression.title: Expression

invisible.description: If true, the metric is excluded from the response but can be used in filters/ordering.
invisible.title: Invisible

name.description: The metric name. Valid realtime metrics: activeUsers, eventCount, keyEvents, screenPageViews.
name.title: Name

metrics.title: Metrics

minuteRanges.description: Time ranges to report on. Default is last 30 minutes. Each range has startMinutesAgo (default 29) and endMinutesAgo (default 0).

items.description: Time range specification for realtime reports.

endMinutesAgo.description: End of the range in minutes ago (default 0 = now).
endMinutesAgo.title: End Minutes Ago

name.description: Optional name for this minute range.
name.title: Name

startMinutesAgo.description: Start of the range in minutes ago (default 29, max 30 for standard or 60 for GA 360).
startMinutesAgo.title: Start Minutes Ago

items.title: MinuteRange

minuteRanges.title: Minute Ranges

property.description: Required. The GA4 property resource name. Format: properties/{property_id}. Get property IDs from GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_LIST_PROPERTIES.
property.title: Property

returnPropertyQuota.description: If true, includes API quota usage info in the response.
returnPropertyQuota.title: Return Property Quota

inputSchema.title: RunRealtimeReportRequest

name: run_realtime_report

DimensionHeader.description: Column header for a dimension in the response.
DimensionHeader.title: DimensionHeader

DimensionValue.description: A dimension value in a report row.
DimensionValue.title: DimensionValue

MetricHeader.description: Column header for a metric in the response.

type.description: The metric data type. Values: TYPE_INTEGER, TYPE_FLOAT, TYPE_SECONDS, TYPE_MILLISECONDS, TYPE_MINUTES, TYPE_HOURS, TYPE_STANDARD, TYPE_CURRENCY, TYPE_FEET, TYPE_MILES, TYPE_METERS, TYPE_KILOMETERS.
type.title: Type

MetricHeader.title: MetricHeader

MetricValue.description: A metric value in a report row.

value.description: The metric value as a string.
value.title: Value

MetricValue.title: MetricValue

PropertyQuota.description: API quota status for the property.

serverErrorsPerProjectPerHour.description: Server error quota per project per hour.
serverErrorsPerProjectPerHour.title: Server Errors Per Project Per Hour

tokensPerProjectPerHour.description: Tokens per project per hour quota.
tokensPerProjectPerHour.title: Tokens Per Project Per Hour

PropertyQuota.title: PropertyQuota

QuotaStatus.description: Quota consumption status for a quota type.
QuotaStatus.title: QuotaStatus

ReportRow.description: A single data row in the report.
ReportRow.title: ReportRow

RunRealtimeReportResponse.description:
Response model for runRealtimeReport API.
Contains report data with dimension/metric headers, data rows, aggregations, and quota info.

dimensionHeaders.description: Column headers for dimensions in the report.
dimensionHeaders.title: Dimension Headers

maximums.description: Maximum values if 'MAXIMUM' was requested in metricAggregations.
maximums.title: Maximums

metricHeaders.description: Column headers for metrics with name and data type.
metricHeaders.title: Metric Headers

minimums.description: Minimum values if 'MINIMUM' was requested in metricAggregations.
minimums.title: Minimums

propertyQuota.description: API quota usage info. Only returned if returnPropertyQuota=true.
propertyQuota.title: Property Quota

rowCount.description: Total number of rows matching the query (may exceed returned rows if limit applied).
rowCount.title: Row Count

rows.description: Data rows containing dimension and metric values.
rows.title: Rows

totals.description: Aggregated totals if 'TOTAL' was requested in metricAggregations.
totals.title: Totals

RunRealtimeReportResponse.title: RunRealtimeReportResponse
